description: This file defines an abstract class 'VersionedGestureDetector' with multiple nested subclasses tailored for different Android SDK versions to handle touch gestures, including drag and scale gestures. It provides a factory method to instantiate the appropriate detector based on the device's SDK version.

classes.name: VersionedGestureDetector
classes.description: Abstract class providing gesture detection functionalities adaptable to Android SDK versions.

classes.name: CupcakeDetector
classes.description: Detects basic drag gestures for very old Android versions prior to Eclair.

classes.name: EclairDetector
classes.description: Enhances gesture detection for newer versions (Eclair and above), including multi-touch handling.

classes.name: FroyoDetector
classes.description: Adds scale gesture detection capabilities using ScaleGestureDetector for Froyo and above.

methods.name: VersionedGestureDetector.newInstance
methods.description: Factory method that creates a gesture detector instance suitable for the current Android SDK version.

methods.name: VersionedGestureDetector.OnGestureListener
methods.description: Interface for gesture event callbacks, including onDrag and onScale.
